settings-workspace.purpose: Product users manage profile, notification, theme, security, and danger-zone preferences as one governed workspace.
qualityGates: Section selection keeps Tabs, root state, and preference content synchronized.
Settings controls are delegated to Preference Management and Settings, not locally rendered by the template.
Danger-zone behavior is delegated to Confirmation Dialog through Preference Management.
agentInstructions: This template is the full product settings workspace.
Use Tabs only for workspace section navigation; preference controls, form blocks, validation, and danger confirmation belong to Preference Management and its child patterns.
Section selection is the primary controlled/uncontrolled state contract.
rejectIf: Template renders switches, selects, inputs, validation, or confirmation dialogs directly outside Preference Management.
Template mutates theme root or density outside Flow contracts.
Template wraps settings groups in Card instead of Surface/Preference Management ownership.
Template bypasses Surface, density, state, or token ownership.
